notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a SECOND, independent synthetic application (Cascade Tank Services, LLC) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C24126Q0704 -- built to add SFT/eval training data with deliberately different failure and compliance shapes from the original application (Granite State Tank Works, LLC).

The original application left most post-split individual items (rov specs, structural defect evidence, references, tool/ladder safety, fascsa/sudan reps, technical standards docs, methodology, work plans, coating/healthcare training, structural experience, infection control docs, hazcom, fall-protection/lockout certs and plans) entirely unaddressed, mostly scoring insufficient_information/non_compliant. This application inverts that: most items are explicitly and specifically addressed (compliant), while two explicit, different-shaped contradictions are planted (a claimed-vs-itemized CPARS count mismatch; an 'all personnel' compliance claim contradicted by an admitted partial-coverage training gap), two explicit self-admitted failures are planted (no ROV capability; license renewal in progress) rather than silence-based ones, one honest capability-gap admission is planted (no prior hospital experience) as a genuine non_compliant that is not simply omission, and confined_space_entry_plan is the sole remaining total omission, kept deliberately rare rather than the dominant pattern.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

Six acceptable_verdicts lists broadened after a real pipeline run on this B variant, matching the same broadenings already made on the base application's true_verdicts.json for these same topic_ids (quantity-shortfall/partial-coverage findings are as defensible read as non_compliant as they are as insufficient_information/contradictory, and a bare UEI is accepted as satisfying a conditional 'if applicable' EFT indicator, consistent with the eft_indicator_if_applicable precedent elsewhere in this corpus).
